title: Add bounded knowledge retrieval
summary: Added deterministic, lossless bounded knowledge retrieval for review skills that caps context at 16,000 UTF-8 bytes per page, returns all applicable catalog rows without filtering or ranking, and validates retrieval through GUID-scoped scratch paths to improve efficiency and validation reliability.
key_points: Implemented capped pagination (16,000 bytes per page) for knowledge-index retrieval with strict UTF-8 and path-safety checks
Returns complete applicable catalog rows without top-k filtering, ranking, or query-based omission to ensure deterministic behavior
Added exact article and sample body retrieval in batches up to eight paths with SHA-256 validation and byte counting
Applied bounded Source workflow to all 16 canonical review skills while preserving existing Relevance, Worklist, Action, and Output rules
Comprehensive validation covers all 282 articles and 457 samples with explicit failure handling for invalid metadata, stale continuations, and oversized batches
quote: Add lossless deterministic catalog paging capped at 16,000 serialized UTF-8 bytes, including the output newline.
